column1: The CNX Nifty Junior closed at 6936.8 points on July 31, 2008 representing a increase of 703.60 points (11.29%) as compared to 6233.2 points on June 30, 2008 . During the month of July 2008, the CNX Nifty Junior touched a high of 7363.20 points on July 24, 2008 before closing at 6936.8 points on July 31, 2008. The market capitalisation of CNX Nifty Junior increased from Rs 379051 crores in June, 2008 to Rs 421873 crores in July, 2008 i.e. a increase of  Rs.42822 crores(11.29%)
* Beta & R2 are calculated for the period  01-August-2007 to 31-July-2008
* Beta measures the  degree to which any portfolio of stocks is affected as compared to the effect on the market as a whole.
* The coefficient of determination (R2) measures the strength of relationship between two variables,
the return on  a security versus that of the market.
* Volatility is the Std. deviation of the daily returns for the period 01-July-2008 to 31-July-2008
* Impact Cost for CNX Nifty Junior is for a portfolio of Rs. 25 lakhs
* Impact Cost for CNX Nifty Junior is the weightage average impact cost
